verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost identical and share the same flaws. The product circle is cropped hard into the top-left corner and leaves a big empty orange area to its right. 'Out now.' is indented and doesn't line up with the headline's left edge. The 'Try It' pill is oversized and pulls attention from the headline. A crowds the headline right under the circle and leaves extra empty space at the bottom. B spaces the elements more evenly down the canvas, though its button sits a little close to the bottom edge.
